game:characterdesc-cobbs-commoner: A generalist ready to make a living wherever they settle.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-sailor: At home on the water, the Sailor fishes for a living and knows how to shake off a soaking.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-lumberjack: A woodsworker who knows how to fell a tree and read the forest around it.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-hunter: A patient stalker skilled at bringing down and dressing game.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-malefactor: An outcast who gets by on a light step and whatever can be salvaged.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-homesteader: A practiced farmhand who turns hard work into thriving fields and a reliable home.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-miner: A prospector who feels most at ease with a light in hand and stone overhead.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-herbalist: A keeper of bees and tender of plants who gathers ingredients for natural remedies.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-potter: A clayworker who shapes raw earth into bricks, vessels, and finer ceramics.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-mason: A builder who works stone from quarry face to finished wall.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-butcher: A steady hand at the cutting table who preserves meat and puts hides to use.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-tailor: A clothier who spins fiber, mends garments, and dresses others for work or ceremony.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-alchemist: An experimenter who brews in bulk and studies how to turn familiar materials into stranger things.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-carpenter: A woodworker who makes barrels, tool handles, and fittings.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-smelter: A furnace worker who casts molten metal and shapes glass.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-scribe: A practiced pen who draws maps and records what others discover.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-caravaneer: A well-traveled trader who knows how to move a load and make contacts along the road.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-ranger: A quick-footed bow user who makes arrows and knows which mushrooms to pick.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-blackguard: A hardened fighter with a big appetite and the strength to endure a long fight.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-knight: An armored defender who stands between others and the creatures of the Rust.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-clockmaker: A mechanic who tinkers with old machines, repurposes their parts, and understands locusts.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-rotwalker: A mystic who studies the Rust, prepares wards, and ventures into temporal storms.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-artisan: A painter and sculptor who brings color and ornament to everyday surroundings.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-chef: A cook who knows how to make a meal their own and pack it for later.
game:characterdesc-cobbs-smith: A forge worker who hammers hot metal into tools worth putting to work.
